main_reasons: Earnings well supported by cash: operating cash flow $9.3M vs net income $5.1M; cash up $13.2M to $31.4M with essentially no debt
Simple, clean balance sheet: no goodwill impairment pressure, small receivables (DSO ~26 days), allowances modest and consistent
Conservative tax accounting: full valuation allowance kept on deferred tax assets despite three years of cumulative profit, so no DTA release props up earnings

Main judgment area is revenue: point-in-time perpetual software licence revenue rose 55% ($4.9M to $7.5M), software Q4 revenue spiked, and the auditor's critical audit matter covers multi-element allocation, standalone selling price and timing
Weaker governance and audit: small regional auditor (Urish Popeck, $294K audit fee), no ICFR attestation, 37% holder controls the company, long-tenured board, several late Form 4s

Many sloppy drafting errors (blank figures, contract terms stated as 36-60 months in one place and 39-90 in another, prior-year Adjusted EBITDA shown as both $8,157 and $8,187, a contradictory valuation-allowance sentence, end users given as five million and seven million) point to weak disclosure controls rather than manipulation
Bonus based on Adjusted EBITDA and revenue, but results beat the caps by a wide margin, so there was little incentive to manage results to a threshold
